subject: Update data set based on plot clicks from ggvis

messages.author: c944e424fd78eae4
messages.subject: Update data set based on plot clicks from ggvis
parts:
I am trying to use a ggvis plot in Shiny to allow users to manually choose points that are useful and then re update the plot based on their inputs.  I have adapted code that I have found around the internet to get the location of the points that they click. I am able to update the database  Unfortunately, I am not able to then re update the ggvis plot in shiny. I'm sure I need either a reactive, isolate, or observe somewhere in my code. Below is my current code for this portion of my app. Any help would be GREAT! Thanks in advance.

clickFunc <- function(data,location,session) {
  curpos<-which(gamemat2$X5==data$X5 & gamemat2$X6==data$X6  & gamemat2$teams==data$teams)
  gamemat2$teams[gamemat2$X9[curpos]]<<-gamemat2$teams[curpos]
  show(gamemat2$teams)
}
  gamemat2 %>% ggvis(x = ~X5,  y = ~X6) %>% 
     layer_text(text:=~teams, fontSize := 10, align:="center") %>% 
     layer_rects(x=~x,x2=~x2,y=~y,y2=~y2,fillOpacity:=0.01) %>%
     handle_click(clickFunc) %>% bind_shiny("ggvis")
